post.title: Starbucks is holding your money
post.ig:
Starbucks is holding billions of dollars of its customers' money.

Load a card or the app, and Starbucks gets the cash before you buy anything.
At the end of fiscal 2024, about $1.78B sat on those balances, earning customers no interest.
Balances that never get spent (breakage) become revenue.

Source: Starbucks annual report (10-K).
News and education, not financial advice.
